discrepancies.evidence: full results/predictions T7/T8/ensemble targets and trusted local T8 test loader
discrepancies.finding: The thesis attributed the CAPACITY_REDUCTION feature's 88.7% zero share to the test target. Full cached targets contain 872,540 exact zeros out of 3,163,500 rows (27.58%).
discrepancies.impact: The stated explanation for selective-prediction and AUROC performance materially overstated target sparsity.
discrepancies.resolution: Published as a post-submission corrigendum; submitted thesis files remain unchanged.

discrepancies.finding: Base training fits separate feature and position scalers on train, validation, and test partitions instead of applying training-fitted scalers throughout.
discrepancies.impact: Evaluation-distribution statistics influence preprocessing; this is not target leakage, but it weakens deployment and method comparability claims.
discrepancies.resolution: Reported as a limitation; historical artifacts were not rewritten.

discrepancies.finding: The trial-specific T8 MC archive and later verification archive are distinct stochastic runs. They produce slightly different MAE, rho, and k-factor values.
discrepancies.impact: Rounded T8 UQ values vary slightly with the cached replay used.
discrepancies.resolution: Dashboard values identify and recompute the trial-specific source; thesis-final reported values remain linked to the verification replay.

discrepancies.finding: Tracked 20/80 graph-level calibration and final-thesis 30/70 random node-level calibration produce different temperature and ECE values.
discrepancies.impact: Calibration claims are protocol-dependent and cannot be pooled.
discrepancies.resolution: Both protocols are named explicitly; the dashboard does not mix them.

discrepancies.finding: Several evaluation scripts use strict=False without key-coverage checks.
discrepancies.impact: Incompatible PyG state dictionaries may silently leave random parameters.
discrepancies.resolution: No checkpoint replay is used in this analysis; cached numeric predictions are the canonical reproducible input.

discrepancies.finding: The thesis says validation R2, while executable base training saves/stops on validation loss and returns final rather than best values.
discrepancies.impact: The training narrative does not exactly describe the implementation.

discrepancies.finding: README says 10,000 simulations; final experiments used 1,000.
discrepancies.impact: Overstates the experimental training sample count.

discrepancies.finding: Documentation called FREESPEED maximum speed and described position order as start/middle/end; code uses free-flow speed and start/end/midpoint.
discrepancies.impact: Feature interpretation and geometry provenance were ambiguous.
discrepancies.resolution: Canonical feature dictionary records executable meanings.
